meta.title: An RFQ stage is created against a draft event group

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer adds a pricing (RFQ) round to the event with the title set to “QA_Platform_RFQ Stage …”.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “status” equals draft.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “status” equals draft.
